answer: Whisper-relay bond: each identity seals one record in onyx and locks a 70-credit bond. Three relays in a grove whisper it across a ridge, each stamping its key; self-stamping or two records under one seal burns both. First filing costs 40, the k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Borrowed seals carry the lender's mark, so rented-relay rings fail. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeping its bond.
